en.headline: Police classify missing City Hall sculptures as theft
en.dek: Officers were alerted Friday afternoon that works worth about HK$160,000 for the Microwave International New Media Arts Festival had gone missing from the Central venue.
body: Police said on Friday that a batch of sculptures worth about HK$160,000 was reported missing from Hong Kong City Hall in Central, and the case has been classified as theft.

Officers were alerted at around 2.30pm that the items, part of an exhibition for the Microwave International New Media Arts Festival, could not be accounted for. The festival’s opening was scheduled for Friday evening, with the public exhibition running from 31 October to 8 November.

The Central district crime investigation team is following up. No arrests have been reported. The Leisure and Cultural Services Department confirmed that the organiser of a hire of the lower block exhibition hall had reported a set of exhibits missing.

Local artist Keith Lam Yan-kit created the styrofoam sculptures, which form part of an eight-piece work. An officer said a carton containing five pieces had been delivered earlier but later disappeared, and police would review CCTV with City Hall management.

zh.headline: 警方列香港大會堂雕塑失竊案為盜竊
zh.dek: 警方周五下午接報，微波國際新媒體藝術節一批約值16萬元雕塑品於中環場地失蹤。
body: 警方周五表示，中環香港大會堂一批約值16萬元的雕塑品被報失，案件已列作盜竊。
警方約下午2時半接報，指這些屬於微波國際新媒體藝術節展覽的展品不知所終。藝術節原定周五晚上舉行開幕禮，主題展覽將於10月31日至11月8日向公眾開放。
中區刑事調查隊正跟進，暫未有人被捕。康樂及文化事務署確認，租用大會堂低座展覽廳的主辦機構已就一組展品失蹤報警。
本地藝術家林欣傑創作了這些發泡膠雕塑，屬一套八件作品的一部分。一名警員稱，一個裝有五件展品的紙箱早前已送抵場地，其後消失，警方會與大會堂管理方檢視閉路電視。
